title: Anthropic releases an open standard for connecting AI to apps and data
summary: Anthropic released the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that gives AI assistants one common way to connect to other tools and data, like Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, or a database. Before this, each connection had to be custom-built. Anthropic made the rules and a set of ready-made connectors free and open source, and companies including Block and Replit said they were already using or building with it.
why_it_matters: It works like a universal plug: build one MCP connector for a tool, and any AI app that supports MCP can use it.
